business: Greenside: white-label member app + club management software for Dutch golf clubs
by_segment: Board member or paid club manager of an 18-hole club (±950 members, turnover around 1.8 million euro)
Club manager or commercial manager of a 27+ hole club or a commercially run course (±1,350 members)
Volunteer board member of a 9-hole club (±550 members, mostly volunteers)
by_behaviour: Still on E-Golf4U, must choose a new system now
Cautious chair, goes through the members' meeting
why_not: We have to replace E-Golf4U and I can't afford to bet 950 members on two founders with no club live yet. The pilot terms and the escrow are genuinely good, but I'd put Greenside on the shortlist and wait for Zwolle while we talk to Nexxchange and IntoGolf.

The pilot costing nothing is nice, but in the end it's another 465 to 618 euros a month on top of what we already pay, and I'm not putting two founders nobody has heard of in front of the board before Zwolle has actually shown it works. I'll wait for their results page and the next budget round.

We left E-Golf4U less than a year ago and the volunteers and members are only just used to the new system. Even a free pilot means a second switch on the horizon, and I can't take that to the board or the members' meeting right now.

We moved off E-Golf4U less than a year ago, the volunteers are exhausted and members have only just learned the new system. I am not putting another switch to the members' meeting this soon, however well you package it, and certainly not with a company of two people.

Our current system works well enough and the vendor knows our club; I'm not going to put a switch to a two-founder startup on the board agenda before Zwolle has shown it actually works. The pilot without double work is a fair offer, but nobody here is asking for a new app right now.

Our system has worked for years and the vendor knows us; members already book and pay through GOLF.NL for free. For a 9-hole club run by volunteers, adding roughly 270 to 360 euros a month for a nicer app is hard to sell to the members' meeting when the real complaint is just finding the booking link on the phone.
